quotes.text: Power Apps is what the industry calls a low-code platform. Low-code means you're writing less code, not zero code. You might still type some formulas, but they're simple.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Clears up the common misconception that low-code means no code at all.

quotes.text: The real value isn't any single feature. It's the integration. Your app lives inside Teams, pulls data from SharePoint, sends notifications through Outlook, and uses the same security that protects your email.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Explains what sets Power Apps apart from generic app builders.

quotes.text: Choose canvas apps when the look and feel matters more, when you need to control every pixel. Choose model-driven apps when handling lots of data, and complex relationships is more important than visual design.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Gives a simple decision rule between the two Power Apps app types.

quotes.text: The agent doesn't replace people. It handles the tedious coordination so people can focus on decisions.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Frames autonomous agents as support for people rather than a replacement.

quotes.text: You describe what you need in plain English. The AI generates the technical work and you focus on the business problem. Whether you call yourself a citizen developer or a professional developer, the workflow is starting to look the same.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Captures how AI is blurring the line between low-code and pro-code.

takeaways: Power Apps is the low-code app builder of the Power Platform, and its real strength is deep integration with Microsoft 365, Entra ID and hundreds of connectors.
Canvas apps give pixel-level design control for task-focused apps, while model-driven apps generate their interface from Dataverse tables for complex data.
Copilot and external AI tools like Claude Code now generate apps from plain-English descriptions, but preview features still need review before production use.
hook: Stuck with a messy spreadsheet because a custom app seems to need a developer and months of work? This episode explains Power Apps for business users, citizen developers and IT pros: canvas versus model-driven apps, Dataverse and connectors, security and governance, and how Copilot and AI tools now build apps from plain English.
